column69: Welcome to Arizona Storage Inns Carefree Crossings located on 7th Street just north of Carefree Highway. We are home grown We are proud to be an Arizona based company, unlike most of the storage facilities surrounding us which are from out of state.  We are conveniently located, for easy access, on your way out of town, be it to the mountains, to the lakes or to your other outdoor activities.  Our facility has both self-storage and covered and uncovered RV/Boat storage and features many state of the art features including ALARMS on all of the storage unit doors for added security, extensive digital video surveillance and electronically controlled access gates.  We have a variety of storage unit sizes* ranging from 5' x 5' to as large as 10 x 25. In addition to regular un-cooled storage spaces, we have fully air conditioned storage spaces for comfort and cleanliness. All of our storage units are ground level. So, you do not have to get into an elevator and spend precious moving time to take you to upper floors. Whatever your need, we have the storage solutions to help you.  For added security for our RV and boat owners, our RV/Boat covered and uncovered storage area is separated from the self storage units by a wrought iron fence and another electronically operated gate reserved only for our RV and boat storage customers. Our RV storage canopies handle all Class A recreational vehicles. Our covered spaces are mostly 12x32 and 12x47. We also offer, for your convenience, outlets for trickle charging your batteries while in storage, a dump station to empty your holding tanks after returning from your recreational adventures.  Oh, and our managers reside on the premises  Our location is about three miles east from Interstate 17 Freeway (I-17), which makes it quite convenient to escape out of town, to go north on the I-17 towards Flagstaff and the Grand Canyon, Sedona via 89A , to Payson via SR260 or to go west on SR74 to Lake Pleasant, Wickenburg and further to SR93 towards Kingman and Las Vegas and also to get onto Loop 303 towards the southwest, to access the I-10 and I-8 Freeways to California.  We look forward to serving you and our community.

 Indoor Storage

 Contactless Rentals

 Student Storage

 People often turn to self-storage when they need to store something, but don't need it all the time. Not only will your items be securely kept, but you'll also be able to collect them whenever you need them, freeing up more space in your office or home. 
 
 Student Storage near UC Berkeley:

Our 5x5 and 5x10 units are usually big enough for the majority of students' needs and rent for less than residential space, allowing them to save money on larger quarters.

 Limited to designated units at designated facilities. No substitutions are permitted.
